text:
chen: Quick heads up — I can repro on prod. Switch org fast, open Console -> Billing -> Quota usage, the chart's last two bars show numbers from previous workspace for ~1-3s before correcting. Happened for 2 customers.

olivia: repro steps?

chen: 1) switch org from A -> B via left nav quickly 2) click Quota usage 3) chart shows A's bars then refreshes. Noticed curl to /internal/metrics/usage returns the A payload on first call. :thinking:

mike: Could be caching at gateway/edge. Do we set Vary or workspace header in cache key?

olivia: Here's curl I ran:

```bash
curl -i 'https://console.redwood.ai/internal/metrics/usage?range=30d' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx' \
  -H 'x-workspace-id: b-123'
```

response is A's payload when switching rapidly.

chen: logs show gateway cache hit: "edge_cache: hit key=metrics:usage?range=30d" but no workspace id suffix.

sara: Our rollout fallback path (canary off) intentionally returns cached tiles for speed — but we should never return cross-workspace caches. If edge cache key lacks workspace, that explains it.

mike: Envoy config snippet — probable culprit:

```yaml
cache_manager:
  name: 'shared_cache'
  key: "%REQ(:path)%"
```

we need to include `%REQ(x-workspace-id)%`

olivia: Agreed. Also internal API sometimes gets workspace via cookie/session, not header — that's flaky under rapid switch.

chen: Proposed hotfix: 1) change cache key to include x-workspace-id 2) add unit test for switching header presence 3) temporarily disable cached fallback for /internal/metrics/* until fixed.

sara: +1. Also we should update Console rollout UX: when switching org, show "loading — validating scope" overlay until first confirmed workspace-scoped API response. Avoid flicker exposing wrong data.

deploy-bot: deploy/v2.14.1 started (canary).

olivia: I'll open PR for cache key + tests. Will tag @mike for Envoy patch. PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-4321 :eyes: 

mike: I'll follow up on Envoy config and make a canary-safe change. Also adding telemetry metric: console.cache.cross_workspace_hits count.

chen: Filing incident ticket for customers affected, and adding audit logs to check if any sensitive reads happened across orgs (likely not persisted). Filing: INC-2025-77.

sara: Nice. QA checklist: reproduce, load test rapid switches, verify no cross-org cache hits.

olivia: ETA PR by EOD. Anyone object to disabling cached fallback for /internal/metrics/* in canary?

mike: no objection. :thumbsup: 

chen: Thanks — will triage and ping infra once PR ready. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy/v2.14.1 finished (canary) — no changes to cache yet.
